items.title: Ukraine news: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Kyiv-controlled territory
items.summary: After Melania Trump reportedly brokered a localized truce, residents of Ukraine's Oleshky managed to leave the occupied city. Meanwhile, Kyiv claimed a hit on a Russian rocket fuel plant. DW has more Oleshky civilians arrive in Ukrainian territory from Belarus Ukraine claims it hit a Russian plant producing solid fuel for rockets and missiles Kyiv also reports strikes on military depots in occupied Ukrainian territory Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Istanbul for talks with Turkey's Recep Tayyip Erdogan Here is a roundup of events from Russia's war in Ukraine on Saturday and Sunday, October 31 and November 1: A drone attack caused "significant damage" to an industrial facility east of Moscow , a Russian governor said, following Ukrainian reports of a strike on a major oil refinery Nizhny Novgorod Governor Gleb Nikitin reported a "massive drone attack" overnight, saying more than 100 drones were destroyed. Preliminary information indicated no casualties, he added Nikitin did not identify the damaged facility.

items.title: Mozambique’s exchange rate reform aims for gradual shift towards a market-led exchange rate – minister
items.summary: “We also have the chapter on exchange rate reform, which aims to move gradually and in a guided manner towards a market-led exchange rate,” Carla Loveira said, presenting measures under way or planned at a meeting with businesspeople in Maputo The position, expressed during a meeting held as part of a Business Breakfast dedicated to fiscal policy, the business environment and private-sector priorities for the country’s economic growth, organised by the Confederation of Economic Associations of Mozambique (CTA), comes amid debate over difficulties in accessing foreign currency and the process by which the central bank sets the exchange rate In practice, due to the lack of access to foreign currency through the banking system, businesspeople end up resorting to buying currency through alternative channels, at rates considerably above the official exchange rate.

items.title: Mozambique: Businesspeople call for suspension of grain import centralisation

items.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
items.summary: Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi is leading Sunday's protest rally Tens of thousands of people have gathered in Delhi for a major opposition rally demanding the resignation of the India's chief election commissioner over a controversial revision of voter lists The rally, organised by the opposition INDIA alliance and led by Rahul Gandhi's Congress party, is taking place at Ramlila Maidan, a sprawling ground in central Delhi known for hosting major political and cultural events Gandhi and several senior opposition leaders arrived at the venue after travelling in a jeep through crowds of supporters The event is the latest show of opposition anger over a voter-list revision exercise that has removed 130 million names from draft electoral rolls in India Among those attending are senior Congress leaders Sonia Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, as well as prominent opposition figures Mamata Banerjee, Akhilesh Yadav, Mehbooba Mufti, Supriya Sule and Tejashwi Yadav The exercise, known as the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), is intended to update electoral rolls by removing the names of people…

items.title: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training
items.summary: The training comes as Ethiopia faces continued fighting in parts of the northern Tigray region Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has put his cabinet ministers and other senior government officials through military training, saying armed forces discipline can help build stronger leaders and advance the country's development Photos shared by him on social media show him taking part in military exercises alongside ministers, deputy ministers and heads of government institutions at the Hurso military training centre The move is unusual in Ethiopia, where senior civilian government officials are rarely seen undergoing military training Those taking part include Speaker of the House of Federation Muferiat Kamil, Finance Minister Fitsum Assefa and Health Minister Mekdes Daba It is unclear when the training began or how long it is expected to last In his post, the prime minister, who is known as Abiy, said Ethiopia's ambition to achieve universal prosperity required its leadership to be physically fit, morally strong and intellectually capable He said military institutions offered…
